test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the traditional dance form of the state of Sikkim?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chutkay**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chutkay **is the traditional dance form of the state of Sikkim.
 
• Through this **romantic group dance**, performed by a **group of male and female dancers**, joys of life and feeling of happiness is shared during the harvesting season and on some other happy occasions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
